_doc: Per-style band for kit/audio/score.py, read from each STYLE.md sound palette. import_styles.py --relayer copies it into style.json stylist.score. Keys: genre (groove backbone), pad, bass, lead, counter (trades bars with the lead, merges at the peak), pulse, sparkle, drums (genre|kit|brushes|hand|wood|orch|taiko|chip|machine|none), mode, bpm, space (dry|small-room|vintage-hall|tape|speaker|cathedral: reverb, band limits, tape drive), duck_db (music bed vs voice, dB; default by genre), lowpass, highpass, tape, avoid (instruments the palette forbids, checked by the critique), note. Voices: lemo sampler names, synths (square pulse25 pulse12 triangle saw supersaw pluck theremin sinebell epiano synthbass pad) or pluck:<guqin|pipa|shamisen|koto|banjo|acoustic_guitar|nylon_guitar|harp|kalimba|music_box>.

ascii-crt.note: analog synth score, square sequencers, silence as an instrument

shadow-puppet.note: percussion first: barrel drum, clapper, gongs; erhu line

visual-investigation.note: investigation bed: pulse, low pad, a bell for each freeze

watercolor.note: acoustic and gentle: felt piano, fingerpicked guitar, woodwinds, light strings

white-model.note: mallets and glass for light, bowed vibraphone, timpani and low brass for weight

whiteboard.note: clockwork minimalism: marimba, pizzicato, woodblock, glockenspiel

woodcut.note: low strings, log drum, woodblock, timpani, one tam-tam
